constraints: Do not treat delivery as proof of adoption.
evaluation: The receiver observes invocation of the adopted work.
limitations: Observed invocation does not prove every downstream outcome.

steps.expected: The receiver defines its own acceptance checks.
steps.instruction: Define receiver-owned checks before installing or applying prior work.

steps.expected: The receiver observes the supplied work in use.
steps.instruction: After local verification, observe whether the receiver actually invokes the supplied work.

summary: Distinguish delivery, integration, and verified adoption with receiver-owned checks and observed use.
